## Summary

Describe the user-facing behavior and affected module.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] Ran backend validation relevant to the change.
- [ ] Ran frontend lint/build or browser validation when UI changed.
- [ ] Documented optional extras, schema, data-retention, or migration impact.

## Safety Review

- [ ] No credentials, local data, checkpoints, or generated reports are included.
- [ ] Server-owned authorization, evidence binding, and lifecycle boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Forecast changes use pinned, verified local assets and do not enable remote code.
